function.name: stackchan_get_state
function.description: Read the currently bound StackChan device state and advertised capabilities, including online/freshness flags, calibration, enabled channels, pose limits and supported expressions. This does not control hardware.

function.name: stackchan_perform
function.description: Execute a bounded sequence of head poses, light settings and screen frames chosen by the agent. Returns accepted only after device acknowledgement; accepted does not mean completed. Query stackchan_get_command for completion. Device selection and authorization are supplied by the gateway session. Before planning head motion, read fresh state and capabilities. For each head frame, compute distance=max(abs(target_yaw-previous_yaw),abs(target_pitch-previous_pitch)); the first frame starts at the measured pose, later frames at the previous head target. move_ms must be at least ceil(1000*distance/head.max_speed_deg_s); allow an additional 250 ms settling margin rather than using the speed boundary. For example, -20 to +20 degrees at 30 deg/s needs at least 1334 ms, preferably 1584 ms or longer, not 500 ms. Recompute subsequent at_ms and duration_ms when changing move_ms. Keep all timing and frame limits; reduce repetitions or amplitude if needed. OUT_OF_RANGE can mean excessive speed as well as position or sequence limits; inspect error details, never infer locking or calibration faults. Do not blindly retry rejected or timed-out motion.

head.description: Absolute pose in calibrated robot coordinates: positive yaw is robot-right, positive pitch is up; zero is calibrated neutral. Device capability bounds may be narrower. Requires head.enabled and valid calibration.

light.description: Set all body RGB LEDs together. Brightness is multiplied by the locally enforced device brightness ceiling.

screen.description: Use only expressions/pages advertised by the device. Text is plain Unicode, at most 80 code points, with no markup or network asset URLs.

parameters.description: Schedule bounded hardware frames on the bound device. Frames are strictly increasing in at_ms, first at_ms is zero, all transitions finish by duration_ms, and transitions on the same channel must not overlap. One running command per device; BUSY is an error. These cross-field conditions are enforced by the executor in addition to schema validation.

function.name: stackchan_get_command
function.description: Read the latest observed status of a command for the current binding. UNKNOWN means completion is unconfirmed; do not automatically repeat physical actions.

function.name: stackchan_stop
function.description: Stop current motion and pending frames and clear the current display/light scene to the device idle state. The gateway invalidates in-flight commands from the previous control generation. Does not move the head home.
